name: mermaid-viewer
description: Opens the diagram viewer pages that the mermaid-render Claude Code mod writes, as a webview tab inside VS Code: pinch-zoom, wheel zoom, drag, source, save.

commands.title: Mermaid Viewer: Open a viewer page…

mermaidViewer.maximize.description: Maximize the editor group when a viewer opens, so the diagram takes the whole editor area; the layout is restored when the last viewer closes.
